definitions.explanation: A style of Japanese cuisine where food is cooked on a flat iron griddle, typically in front of diners. Often features beef, seafood, and vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄板焼|てっぱんや}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I want to eat teppanyaki tonight.

examples.japanese: {鉄板焼|てっぱんや}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a reservation at a teppanyaki restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鉄板焼|てっぱんや}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}して→調理する：26793_chourisuru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The chef cooks teppanyaki right in front of you.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧ (iron plate, griddle) + ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (grilling, cooking)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{鉄板焼|てっぱんや}き restaurants often feature skilled chefs who perform cooking theatrically in front of guests. It is considered a more upscale dining experience in Japan.

- ⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧ (wagyu beef)
